translated_title: Sheinbaum Analyzes Initiative to Prohibit Dual Nationality in the Presidency and Governorships
original_title: Sheinbaum analiza iniciativa para prohibir doble nacionalidad en presidencia y gubernaturas
author: Anahí Del Ángel
meta_description: President Claudia Sheinbaum said the federal government is weighing a constitutional reform to bar people with dual nationality from running for president or governor.
